submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on the token that completes a proper-name reference to a specific person, place, organization, or work: usually the final subword of a multi-token name (Dream+Works, Sad+kin, New+Jersey, Sioux+Falls) or a single-token name in a naming frame (John, Paris). It stays near zero on the name's earlier pieces and on generic common nouns (city, software, sea) in the same frames.
